'''Mindi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the wife of [[Galway Bourke]] and a member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] that fought against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was later captured and executed by Imperial forces when traitors turned several resistance members over to the Empire.
